title: Inhibition of inflammation by berberine: Molecular mechanism and network pharmacology analysis.
authors: Wang, Kaijun; Yin, Jie; Chen, Jiayi; Ma, Jie; Si, Hongbin; Xia, Diqi
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文综述小檗碱的抗炎药理机制，虽提及网络药理学和分子对接，但核心是炎症信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), renowned for its holistic approach with a 2000-year history of utilizing natural remedies, offers unique advantages in disease prevention and treatment. Berberine, found in various Chinese herbs, has been employed for many years, primarily for addressing conditions such as diarrhea and dysentery. Berberine has recently become a research focus owing to its pharmacological activities and benefits to human bodies. However, little is known about the anti-inflammatory mechanism of berberine. PURPOSE: To summarize recent findings regarding the pharmacological effects and mechanisms of berberine anti-inflammation and highlight and predict the potential therapeutic effects and systematic mechanism of berberine. METHODS: Recent studies (2013-2023) on the pharmacological effects and mechanisms of berberine anti-inflammation were retrieved from Web of Science, PubMed, Google Scholar, and Scopus up to July 2023 using relevant keywords. Network pharmacology and bioinformatics analysis were employed to predict the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of berberine against potential diseases. RESULTS: The related pharmacological mechanisms of berberine anti-inflammation include the inhibition of inflammatory cytokine production (e.g., IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha), thereby attenuating the inflammatory response; Inhibiting the activation of NF-kappaB signaling pathway and IkappaBalpha degradation; Inhibiting the activation of MAPK signaling pathway; Enhancing the activation of the STAT1 signaling pathway; Berberine interacts directly with cell membranes through a variety of pathways, thereby influencing cellular physiological activities. Berberine enhances human immunity and modulates immune system function, which is integral to addressing certain autoimmune and tumour-related health concerns. CONCLUSION: This study expounds on the correlation between berberine and inflammatory diseases, encapsulating the mechanisms through which berberine treats select typical inflammatory ailments. Furthermore, it delves into a deeper understanding of berberine's effectiveness by integrating network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques in the context of treating inflammatory diseases. It provides guidance and reference for berberine's subsequent revelation of the modern scientific connotation of Chinese medicine.
abstract_zh: 背景：中医药（Traditional Chinese Medicine, TCM）以其整体观念著称，拥有2000年利用天然药物治疗疾病的历史，在疾病预防和治疗方面具有独特优势。小檗碱（berberine）存在于多种中草药中，多年来主要用于治疗腹泻和痢疾等疾病。近年来，由于小檗碱的药理活性及其对人体的益处，它已成为研究热点。然而，关于小檗碱的抗炎机制知之甚少。目的：总结小檗碱抗炎药理作用及机制的最新研究进展，并重点阐述和预测小檗碱的潜在治疗效果及系统机制。方法：通过相关关键词，从Web of Science、PubMed、Google Scholar和Scopus数据库中检索截至2023年7月关于小檗碱抗炎药理作用及机制的近期研究（2013-2023年）。采用网络药理学和生物信息学分析预测小檗碱对潜在疾病的治疗效果及机制。结果：小檗碱抗炎的相关药理机制包括：抑制炎症细胞因子（如IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α）的产生，从而减轻炎症反应；抑制NF-κB信号通路激活及IκBα降解；抑制MAPK信号通路激活；增强STAT1信号通路激活；小檗碱通过多种途径直接与细胞膜相互作用，从而影响细胞生理活动。小檗碱增强人体免疫力并调节免疫系统功能，这对于解决某些自身免疫和肿瘤相关健康问题至关重要。结论：本研究阐述了小檗碱与炎症性疾病之间的关联，概括了小檗碱治疗某些典型炎症性疾病的机制。此外，通过整合网络药理学和分子对接技术，在治疗炎症性疾病的背景下深入理解小檗碱的有效性。这为小檗碱后续揭示中医药现代科学内涵提供了指导和参考。
